title.en: Anne Carson wins the Nobel. Why does her marriage story take 29 tangos?
title.zh: 安妮·卡森摘诺奖：婚姻故事为何要跳29支探戈？

summary.en: The Swedish Academy honours a writer who crosses genres. Its biography describes a 29-part literary marriage drama; it is not a verified account of her own marriage.
summary.zh: 瑞典学院表彰跨越文类的作家。官方传记介绍29段文学婚姻故事；作品情节不能写作作者本人的婚姻事实。

title.en: Microsoft gives AI agents three modes. Which one actually blocks access?
title.zh: 微软给AI三种模式：哪一种真能拦住越界？

summary.en: Microsoft announces MXC general availability. Permissive records access without enforcing the policy; Learning blocks and records it.
summary.zh: 微软宣布MXC正式可用。Permissive记录却允许政策原本禁止的访问；Learning则拦截并记录。
